title: Dynasty Undisturbed: Buducnost Sweep Studentski Centar for an 18th Crown and the Double
description: There is nothing new about Buducnost lifting the Montenegrin championship, and there was nothing new about the manner of it either. The blue-and-white machine closed out the Prva A Liga final by beating Studentski Centar 94-84 on Thursday, completing a clean sweep of the title series and claiming the club's 18th national crown. It was a fitting bookend to a final that was never truly competitive on the scoreboard. Andrej Zakelj's side had crushed Studentski Centar 104-81 in the opener, and the rematch followed a familiar script. Buducnost grabbed control immediately, winning the first quarter 26-17. Studentski Centar punched back to take the second 25-21 and trimmed the gap to 47-42 by halftime, but that was as close as they would get. Buducnost re-established command after the break, edging the third quarter 23-20 to lead 70-62 and matching every Studentski Centar push in the fourth to…

title: Buducnost capture Erste Liga title
description: Derby - Buducnost 69-74 Buducnost are Erste Liga champions. They topped Derby on the road tonight to sweep the championship series. The guests trailed by 3 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 20-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 74-69. Buducnost outrebounded Derby 41-29 including 31 on the defensive glass. Bosnian center Kenan Kamenjas (207-2000) orchestrated the victory with a double-double by scoring 19 points and 13 rebounds. Nigerian-American Rasheed Sulaimon (194-1994, college: Maryland) contributed with 17 points and 4 assists for the winners. Four Buducnost players scored in double figures. The former international point guard Igor Drobnjak (188-2000) replied with 19 points and 5 assists (was perfect 8-for-8 from the free throw line) and the former international Emir Hadzibegovic (204-1996) added 17 points and 5 rebounds in the effort…
imageCaption: Buducnost capture Erste Liga title (Photo:KK Buducnost)

title: Buducnost rally past SC Derby to lift Erste Liga trophy
description: SC Derby - Buducnost 83-90 Buducnost earned the 16th Erste Liga title. They overcame SC Derby in Game 4 of the Finals to capture the trophy. The guests trailed by 1 point after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 9-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 90-83. Buducnost made 19-of-24 free shots (79.2 percent) during the game. 28 personal fouls committed by SC Derby helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American point guard Yogi Ferrell (183-1993, college: Indiana) fired 23 points and 7 assists for the winners. Bosnian center Kenan Kamenjas (207-2000) chipped in 15 points and 9 rebounds. The former international Emir Hadzibegovic (204-1996) produced 16 points and 5 rebounds (on 6-of-7 shooting from the field) and the former international point guard Igor Drobnjak (188-2000) added 16 points respectively for lost side. title: Erste Liga Round 3 of Finals. Buducnost sweep SC Derby to capture the trophy
description: Buducnost - SC Derby 103-87 Buducnost earned Erste Liga title. They overcame SC Derby in Game 3 of the Finals to complete the sweep of the championship series. The victory marked the 15th League trophy for Buducnost. The game was mostly controlled by Buducnost. SC Derby managed to win third quarter 21-15. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Buducnost shot 63.8 percent from the field. Buducnost outrebounded SC Derby 31-17 including a 22-11 advantage in defensive rebounds. They shot the lights out from three sinking 16 long-distance shots on high 53.3 percentage. Buducnost looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists. The best player for the winners was American J.J. O'Brien (200-1992, college: SDSU, agency: Slash Sports) who scored 30 points and 8 rebounds. Canadian guard Trae Bell-Haynes (188-1995, college: Vermont) chipped in 10 points and 9…

title: Erste Liga Round 5 of Finals. Buducnost top Mornar to capture the trophy
description: Buducnost - Mornar 90-82 Buducnost became the Erste League champions. They prevailed against Mornar in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the 14th League title. Buducnost made 25-of-32 free shots (78.1 percent) during the game. 28 personal fouls committed by Mornar helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American point guard Kendrick Perry (183-1992, college: YSU) orchestrated the victory by scoring 27 points, 5 rebounds and 6 assists. The former international center Zoran Nikolic (212-1996, agency: BeoBasket) contributed with 9 points and 7 rebounds for the winners. Buducnost's coach Aleksandar Dzikic used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. title: Buducnost capture Erste Liga title
description: Buducnost - Mornar Bar 94-70 Buducnost earned Prva Liga title. They fired past Mornar Bar in the third game of the championship series to capture the trophy. Buducnost led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They made 20-of-26 free shots (76.9 percent) during the game. Buducnost looked well-organized offensively handing out 23 assists. It was a good game for the former international center Zoran Nikolic (212-96, agency: BeoBasket) who led his team to a victory with a double-double by scoring 19 points and 13 rebounds (perfect from the field making all seven shots !!!). The former international guard Nikola Ivanovic (190-94, agency: BeoBasket) contributed with 19 points and 8 assists for the winners.
